intro.text: Wayne's mother, who raised him in the mining town of Tinweight Settlement.

items.text: She took in laundry while Wayne's father worked the mines of the Tinweight Settlement, until he died in a collapse. Wayne's uncle Gregr moved in and took his place at the mines, building cheap furniture for the household, though Wayne came to hate him. When Gregr also died in a mining accident, she went down the mines herself, and Wayne took over the laundry to bring in extra money.

One night in 319 PC she came home to find Wayne still awake and learned he had been stealing again. She told him it wasn't right, then told him a story about Allomancer Jak. It was Wayne's last good memory of her: the next day another collapse at the mine killed her.

personality.text: Close to Wayne, who could make her smile after the hardest day; she loved silly voices and telling him tales of the Roughs, but worried about his stealing and swearing, and privately feared she was a poor parent. She speaks with a Roughs dialect.
